metadata.title: Rego Policy Libraries — apra_cps234 (APRA CPS 234 Information Security (Australia, July 2019))

controls.title: The Board is ultimately responsible for information security and ensures it is maintained commensurate with the size and extent of threats, enabling continued sound operation

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Board is ultimately responsible for information security and ensures it is maintained commensurate with the size and extent of threats, enabling continued sound operation

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities of the Board, senior management, governing bodies and individuals (decision-making, approval, oversight, operations) are clearly defined

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information security roles and responsibilities of the Board, senior management, governing bodies and individuals (decision-making, approval, oversight, operations) are clearly defined

controls.title: An information security capability commensurate with the size and extent of threats to information assets is maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An information security capability commensurate with the size and extent of threats to information assets is maintained

controls.title: The information security capability of each related party or third party managing information assets is assessed, commensurate with the potential consequences of an incident

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information security capability of each related party or third party managing information assets is assessed, commensurate with the potential consequences of an incident

controls.title: The capability is actively maintained against changes in vulnerabilities and threats, including from changes to information assets or the business environment

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The capability is actively maintained against changes in vulnerabilities and threats, including from changes to information assets or the business environment

controls.title: An information security policy framework commensurate with exposures to vulnerabilities and threats is maintained

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: An information security policy framework commensurate with exposures to vulnerabilities and threats is maintained

controls.title: The policy framework provides direction on the responsibilities of all parties obliged to maintain information security (staff, contractors, consultants, related and third parties, customers)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The policy framework provides direction on the responsibilities of all parties obliged to maintain information security (staff, contractors, consultants, related and third parties, customers)

controls.title: Information assets, including those managed by related and third parties, are classified by criticality and sensitivity reflecting the potential financial and non-financial impact of an incident

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information assets, including those managed by related and third parties, are classified by criticality and sensitivity reflecting the potential financial and non-financial impact of an incident

controls.title: Information security controls protect information assets, implemented in a timely manner and commensurate with vulnerabilities and threats, criticality and sensitivity, life-cycle stage, and the poten

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information security controls protect information assets, implemented in a timely manner and commensurate with vulnerabilities and threats, criticality and sensitivity, life-cycle stage, and the potential consequences of an incident

controls.title: The design of each related party's or third party's information security controls protecting the entity's information assets is evaluated

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The design of each related party's or third party's information security controls protecting the entity's information assets is evaluated

controls.title: Robust mechanisms detect and respond to information security incidents in a timely manner

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Robust mechanisms detect and respond to information security incidents in a timely manner

controls.title: Information security response plans are maintained for incidents that could plausibly occur

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information security response plans are maintained for incidents that could plausibly occur

controls.title: Response plans include mechanisms for managing all stages from detection to post-incident review, and for escalation and reporting to the Board, governing bodies and responsible individuals

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Response plans include mechanisms for managing all stages from detection to post-incident review, and for escalation and reporting to the Board, governing bodies and responsible individuals

controls.title: Information security response plans are reviewed and tested annually to ensure they remain effective and fit-for-purpose

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information security response plans are reviewed and tested annually to ensure they remain effective and fit-for-purpose

controls.title: Control effectiveness is tested through a systematic testing program whose nature and frequency match the rate of change in threats, asset criticality and sensitivity, incident consequences, exposure

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Control effectiveness is tested through a systematic testing program whose nature and frequency match the rate of change in threats, asset criticality and sensitivity, incident consequences, exposure to untrusted environments, and the materiality and frequency of change

controls.title: Where reliance is placed on a related party's or third party's control testing, the nature and frequency of that testing is assessed against paragraph 27(a)–(e)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Where reliance is placed on a related party's or third party's control testing, the nature and frequency of that testing is assessed against paragraph 27(a)–(e)

controls.title: Testing results that identify control deficiencies which cannot be remediated in a timely manner are escalated and reported to the Board or senior management

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Testing results that identify control deficiencies which cannot be remediated in a timely manner are escalated and reported to the Board or senior management

controls.title: Testing is conducted by appropriately skilled and functionally independent specialists

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Testing is conducted by appropriately skilled and functionally independent specialists

controls.title: The sufficiency of the testing program is reviewed at least annually or on material change to information assets or the business environment

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The sufficiency of the testing program is reviewed at least annually or on material change to information assets or the business environment

controls.title: Internal audit reviews the design and operating effectiveness of information security controls, including those maintained by related and third parties (control assurance)

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Internal audit reviews the design and operating effectiveness of information security controls, including those maintained by related and third parties (control assurance)

controls.title: Information security control assurance is provided by appropriately skilled personnel

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Information security control assurance is provided by appropriately skilled personnel

controls.title: Internal audit assesses control assurance provided by a related or third party where an incident could materially affect the entity or its customers and audit intends to rely on that assurance

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Internal audit assesses control assurance provided by a related or third party where an incident could materially affect the entity or its customers and audit intends to rely on that assurance

controls.title: APRA is notified as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after becoming aware of an information security incident that materially affected (or could materially affect) the entity or its custome

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: APRA is notified as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after becoming aware of an information security incident that materially affected (or could materially affect) the entity or its customers, or that was notified to another regulator

controls.title: APRA is notified as soon as possible and no later than 10 business days after becoming aware of a material control weakness the entity expects not to remediate in a timely manner

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: APRA is notified as soon as possible and no later than 10 business days after becoming aware of a material control weakness the entity expects not to remediate in a timely manner

controls.title: apra_cps234.third_party_managed_assets must be declared true or false — whether related parties or third parties manage information assets cannot be assumed

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: apra_cps234.third_party_managed_assets must be declared true or false — whether related parties or third parties manage information assets cannot be assumed

parts.prose: CPS 234 para %v (%v): %v — not attested
